title: Anomaly Zone
description:
S.T.A.L.K.E.R.-inspired survival mod: anomalous zones with contamination, upgradeable artifacts, emissions, detectors, and scientific armor. Zone survival, minecraft-flavored.
Requires Terrablender and Curios to work.
body:
**Anomaly Zone brings the atmosphere of S.T.A.L.K.E.R. into Minecraft.** Explore three anomalous biomes — a _Bio, Thermo, Psi_  — each with its own contamination mechanic that builds up the longer you stay. Survive recurring Emissions, hunt down artifacts with a set of detectors, and wear them as trinkets via Curios for a mix of buffs and drawbacks. Upgrade your artifacts at the sharpening bench using energy from anomalous batteries and essences to boost your odds, with a pity bonus kicking in after repeated failures. Suit up in a full scientific armor set built for life in the Zone.
# Requires Terrablender and Curios to work.
